On the way home, I stopped at the corner bakery and picked up a warm blueberry scone that was still crumbly and sweet from the oven, and I’ve been sipping iced lavender latte while flipping through a new gardening magazine I grabbed at the checkout. I’m even daydreaming about planting a small patch of sunflowers along my backyard fence this weekend to attract bees and brighten up the space.
